import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int btcAmount = sc.nextInt();
        int[] btcCosts = new int[100];
        int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            int left = sc.nextInt();
            if (left % 2 == 0) evenCount++;
            else oddCount++;
            if (evenCount == oddCount && i != n - 1) {
                int right = sc.nextInt();
                i++;
                int btcCost = Math.abs(left - right);
                btcCosts[btcCost]++;
                evenCount = 0;
                oddCount = 0;
            }
            i++;
        }
        int sawedAmount = 0;
        int currentBTCCost = 0;
        for (int cost = 0; cost < 100; cost++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < btcCosts[cost]; k++) {
                currentBTCCost += cost;
                if (currentBTCCost <= btcAmount) {
                    sawedAmount++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(sawedAmount);
    }
}
